kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستأيك (form X)
# نَسْتَأْيِكُ (nastaʔyiku) /nas.taʔ.ji.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# نَسْتَأْيِكَ (nastaʔyika) /nas.taʔ.ji.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
# نَسْتَأْيِكْ (nastaʔyik) /nas.taʔ.jik/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَأْيَكَ (istaʔyaka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
